homeConfig.content:
[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/acme-jfrog-io/"

[registry]
global-credential-providers = ["cargo:token"]

[source.spindrift-upstream-acme]
registry = "sparse+https://acme.jfrog.io/artifactory/api/cargo/cargo-local/index/"
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy-acme-jfrog-io-acme"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy-acme-jfrog-io-acme]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/acme-jfrog-io/artifactory/api/cargo/cargo-local/index/"

[registries.spindrift-registry-proxy-acme-jfrog-io-acme]
index = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/acme-jfrog-io/artifactory/api/cargo/cargo-local/index/"
